rights_basis: Two short Latin excerpts from an 1851 public-domain edition. The descriptive line prefixes are Triptych editorial metadata; Triptych claims no exclusive right in the source wording.
text: Si quis prae infirmitate sua vel mollitie jejunium vel austeritatem perferre nequeat, quam confessarius ejus ei praescripserit, ei permissum erit, jejunium suum redimere pietate et mundanis suis possessionibus.
